name: v0.3.3
body:
Lap v0.3.3 adds Photo Collage, tag groups, offline album browsing, and arbitrary-angle straightening. It also brings more RAW preview controls, faster startup and RAW browsing, simpler view switching and multi-select, and six new languages.

##  Highlights

- **Photo Collage** — Compose selected photos into a single shareable image with grid, justified-mosaic, and Picasa-style picture-pile layouts. Move, layer, rotate, and scale photos on the pile, randomize a layout, then export at full resolution from the originals or print to A4 or photo paper at 300 dpi, with customizable page size, orientation, background, spacing, borders, and optional drop shadows. (#358, #387)
- **Tag Groups** — Organize tags into collapsible, reorderable groups with inline editors for creating tags and groups, move tags between groups, and show the group name in content titles. A protected Default group keeps every tag categorized. (#304)
- **Offline Album Browsing** — Albums on disconnected or network storage stay visible across the library with a warning indicator, so you can browse cached thumbnails and metadata without the volumes mounted. Actions that need the original file are clearly gated. (#351)
- **Arbitrary-Angle Straighten** — Fine-tune horizons in crop mode with a ruler slider that snaps to zero, supports keyboard stepping, and live-previews the straightened, cropped result before saving. (#318)
- **RAW Preview Controls** — Choose the preview source (rendered or embedded), adjust render brightness, and control RAW+JPEG pair display, and switch between RAW modes and the paired JPEG/HEIC directly in the viewer. (#331, #369)
- **Six New Languages** — Lap is now available in Hungarian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Ukrainian, and Traditional Chinese, bringing the total to fifteen languages. (#330, #336, #343, #364)

## New Features and Improvements

- Added native file drag-out: drag photos and videos from the grid or the viewer straight into Finder, Explorer, or other apps as real files, with a thumbnail drag preview and support for up to 1,000 files at once. (#339)
- Added a thumbnail navigator to the File Info preview, showing the whole image with a draggable viewport box for quick navigation, scroll-to-zoom, double-click to fit, and rotation-aware positioning.
- Added in-view sorting and sidebar search, letting you reorder and filter results without leaving the current view. (#396)
- Unified grid, filmstrip, and map into mutually exclusive view modes with a single switch. (#315)
- Added configurable map photo marker size, and improved map clustering and transitions. (#307)
- Added per-album exclusions with a scan preview, replacing the global small-image filter with per-album file-type, small-image, and folder exclusions. (#322, #332)
- Added importing files directly into an album folder, respecting the album's exclusions and scan safety.
- Added "Refresh file info" for multi-selections to re-read metadata for several files at once. (#368)
- The image viewer now bidirectionally syncs the current photo with the main-window selection. (#328)
- Added per-library thumbnail cache cleanup in Manage Libraries, with cache sizes shown per library.
- Main-window dialog positions are now remembered across sessions.
- Added an optional navigator sharpness grid to compare focus across shots.
- Consolidated multi-select actions into the selection panel and removed the separate thumbnail double-click action setting. (#347)
- Reworked multi-select so the mode is independent of the selection panel: selecting no longer forces the panel open, and a floating count button opens it on demand, showing the selected count and total size alongside up to 15 selected thumbnails. (#407)
- Added an optional build against the system libheif (`LAP_SYSTEM_LIBHEIF=1`) for distribution packaging. (#359)
- Improved management dialogs, folder actions, and the shared splitter indicator with a delayed hover fade-in.
- Date and time now format according to the system region by default, independent of the UI language. (#390)
- Bundled third-party license notices with the app for easier attribution and compliance.
- Faster startup: heavy background work is deferred until after the first content paints, and languages and sidebar views are now lazy-loaded.
- Faster RAW browsing with reduced-resolution previews and on-demand full-size rendering when zooming in. Distinct icons identify embedded, rendered, and brightened RAW previews.
- Collage page, layout, and style preferences now persist between sessions. Image editor preferences now sync between windows. (#358)

## Bug Fixes

- Aligned video capture times with photos so images and videos from the same shoot sort together correctly. (#400)
- Fixed rotated NEF previews by matching embedded JPEG previews by long/short edge, and extracted embedded JPEGs independently of the RAW decoder. (#360, #361)
- Resolved the HEIF primary image for tiled-grid thumbnails and sizes, and added a robust HEIF decode fallback on Windows and Linux using FFmpeg with a format sniffer. (#349, #355)
- Fixed HEIC decoding on macOS by falling back to native ImageIO. (#321)
- Fixed grouped JPEG previews not fitting their geometry grid cells. (#398)
- Fixed the full image being replaced by the thumbnail when navigating quickly. (#367)
- Centered small RAW previews using explicit layout dimensions, and preserved the RAW preview mode across source changes.
- Restored RAW preview fallbacks: try rendering when an embedded preview is unavailable, and try the embedded preview when rendering fails. If neither works, attempt general image decoding, including JPEG content saved with a RAW extension.
- Fixed RAW+JPEG/HEIC badge highlighting and made switching from the paired image select the current RAW mode before cycling modes. Removed the default focus outline from RAW preview badges on Windows.
- Fixed Live Photo previews not restarting, and made fullscreen backgrounds opaque. (#347)
- Guarded video hover previews against a missing GStreamer sink. (#313)
- Detect database corruption per library and prompt you to switch libraries, preserving the original database file instead of silently rebuilding it. (#326)
- Made database storage migration safe, reporting cleanup failures rather than losing data. (#354)
- Fixed a crash on exit when Aptabase analytics is not enabled. (#372)
- Reloaded visible thumbnails after deletion in grouped view. (#325)
- Fixed inline rename losing focus and Enter unexpectedly opening the dialog.
- Refreshed the current album view after changing exclusions and avoided duplicate default names when creating tags.
- Stopped thumbnail drag from File Info previews and simplified album and preview fields.
- Tracked the satellite map theme separately for the map view and the info panel.
- Showed a duplicate-name warning on drag and drop. (#386)
- Clarified paired files in album scan status. (#392)
- Persisted the preview toolbar pinned position.
- Fixed Windows builds by compiling libde265 at `/O1` on MSVC. (#389, #393)
- Excluded bundled libsystemd and libudev from the AppImage to fix runtime conflicts. (#311)
- Refreshed file info in place without resetting the viewport or scroll position.
- Restored grouping when returning from filmstrip view.
- Stopped "Refresh file info" from downloading unchanged cloud-only files (OneDrive Files On-Demand and macOS dataless files) by detecting them from metadata instead of opening them. (#394, #411)

### Auto Update

For Linux AppImage installations, download the new AppImage from the table above instead of using the built-in updater. This release includes update information and `.zsync` files for future delta updates through compatible external AppImage update tools.

Linux DEB installations can also be updated by downloading and installing the matching DEB package.

## Contributors

This release includes community contributions across features, platform fixes, and translations. Many thanks to:

- **ddcdk** — the Photo Collage studio (grid, justified-mosaic, and picture-pile layouts) (#358, #387), the cloud-only file refresh fixes (#394, #411), and the MSVC libde265 `/O1` Windows build fix (#389, #393).
- **beneedict** — the Fedora COPR release build (#370) and the optional system-libheif build flag (`LAP_SYSTEM_LIBHEIF=1`) (#359).
- **yi111** — the robust HEIF decode fallback on Windows and Linux using FFmpeg with a format sniffer (#349, #355).
- **Daniel Benner** — keeping the full image from being replaced by its thumbnail when navigating quickly (#367).
- **Philip de Bruin** — fixing the crash on exit when Aptabase analytics is not enabled (#372).
- **Tomasz Gospodarczyk** — the Polish locale and README translation (#343).
- **OPGERUIMD97** — the Dutch translation (#364).
- **Dmitry Yerokhin** — Russian translation updates (#320).
- **bakos-andras** — the Hungarian translation (#330).

And thanks to everyone who reported issues and tested development builds.

name: v0.3.2
body:
Lap v0.3.2 brings new ways to explore, import, and organize your photo library. Discover geotagged photos in Map View, play Google Motion Photos, import media into date-based folders, and clean up duplicates across the library. This release also adds sharper thumbnails for large displays, configurable RAW previews, and important fixes for selection, album handling, and Linux AppImage compatibility.

## Highlights

- **Map View** — Explore geotagged photos and videos on an interactive map directly from the main toolbar. The map follows your current view and filters, groups nearby items into clusters with photo counts, and lets you open a cluster to browse its photos. Return to the map without losing your position or zoom. (#223)
- **Google Motion Photos** — Play the embedded video in supported Google/Android Motion Photo JPEGs instead of seeing only the still image. Motion Photos are recognized in existing libraries and appear alongside Apple Live Photos through the unified Live & Motion Photos Smart Album condition. (#18)
- **Import and Organize by Date** — Import photos and videos from a folder into an album, automatically organizing them by day, month, year, or a single destination folder. The workflow preserves original filenames, supports RAW files and Apple adjustment sidecars, skips duplicate content, and provides progress, cancellation, and continuation controls. (#86)
- **Library-Wide Duplicate Cleanup** — Review the space you can reclaim and delete removable copies across all duplicate sets in one action, while preserving the keep choice for each set. (#291)
- **Sharper Thumbnails and Configurable RAW Previews** — Choose thumbnail resolutions up to 1024 px and larger grid sizes for high-resolution displays. For RAW files, choose between RAW rendering and the camera’s embedded preview, with consistent thumbnail and preview behavior. (#274, #275, #269)

## New Features and Improvements

- Added a Tianditu map provider option for browsing maps in China, configurable with your own API token.
- Added date-based import layouts including `YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY/YYYY-MM`, and `YYYY`. Capture dates are used when available, with file modification dates as a fallback. Imported files appear in the album without a separate full scan. (#86)
- Added import summaries showing imported, skipped, and failed files, plus safeguards against importing between identical or nested source and destination folders.
- Added thumbnail quality profiles of 256, 512, and 1024 px, with corresponding grid-size ranges up to 180, 360, and 720 px. (#274)
- Added a RAW thumbnail source setting: RAW Rendering remains the default, while Embedded preview offers the camera-generated image. Both options fall back to the alternative when necessary. (#275, #269)
- Added a Thumbnail corners setting to choose between theme-defined corners and square thumbnails. (#74)
- Added a small-image filter with 160, 320, and 640 px thresholds. It hides an item only when both dimensions are below the threshold, reducing clutter from icons and tiny previews without excluding files from scanning or indexing. Visible results and counts stay consistent across browsing and search. (#258)
- Removed the 1,000-result cap from visual/semantic search and the 10-result cap for regular text, filename, and metadata matches in unified search. Search similarity now consistently controls the relevance cutoff for keyword photo searches. (#279)
- Added automatic loading of additional people as you scroll through the People list. (#279)
- Added a double-click preference to open photos and videos in Quick Preview or a separate viewer window. (#281)
- Unified collection and tag editing. Add or remove selected photos directly in Edit collections, and create, rename, or delete tags from Edit tags, with consistent selection states and feedback. (#283)
- Added a Set As menu for assigning an album cover or setting the selected image as desktop wallpaper. Wallpaper support is available on macOS, Windows, and GNOME Linux, including suitable companion images from RAW+JPEG pairs. (#292)
- Added Page Up and Page Down navigation for browsing photo results. (#296)
- Restored Random sorting for rediscovering photos. Grouping is disabled while Random sorting is active. (#303)
- Improved Calendar browsing with a Year → Month → Day hierarchy, Years/Months/Days tabs, localized month names, and counts at each level.
- Added Camera and Lens tabs with group counts, and kept sidebar item counts visible beside the more menu.
- Added support for managing multiple external applications and choosing a default application.
- Improved File Info with people avatars, an album-cover indicator, clickable previews, and navigation to camera, lens, and location views. Empty tags, collections, and comments are hidden.
- Added counterclockwise view rotation and improved video zooming around the cursor, with panning constrained consistently with the image viewer.
- Improved handling of unavailable albums on removable drives and network storage, retaining their cached folder trees and rechecking availability when accessed.
- Reworked subfolder refresh to update the folder hierarchy without regenerating thumbnails or requiring a full media scan.
- Added a language selector to the welcome screen and preserved the left panel’s expanded or collapsed state between sessions.
- Reorganized Browse and Grid settings and improved labels and translations across supported languages.
- Added embedded AppImage update information and companion `.zsync` files for delta updates through compatible tools such as AppImageUpdate and AppImageLauncher. (#284)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed missing iPhone video camera metadata, including make, model, and software information stored in Apple QuickTime tags, completing the follow-up to the iPhone video import report. (#221)
- Fixed multilingual search-model downloads failing on slow connections by increasing the connection timeout from 3 to 30 seconds and displaying more useful download errors. (#272)
- Fixed duplicate, ghost, and unexpectedly cleared selections in Multi-Select mode, and preserved selection and panel state during content refreshes. (#267)
- Fixed AppImage startup failures and blank windows caused by bundled runtime conflicts on newer Linux distributions, including the reported Fedora 44 GNOME and Wayland cases. (#224, #270, #271)
- Fixed AppImage startup on pure-Wayland systems without XWayland, while respecting an explicitly selected display backend. (#271)
- Fixed AppImage GStreamer plugin discovery and runtime-library conflicts that could prevent video and audio playback. (#271)
- Fixed the Settings button becoming unresponsive after closing the Settings window, so reopening no longer requires restarting Lap. (#285)
- Fixed excessive thumbnail blur for very wide or tall images by avoiding over-reduction of their short edge. (#286)
- Fixed explicitly selected album roots being skipped because they report hidden attributes, including Windows NTFS drive roots that previously indexed zero files. Hidden child files and folders remain excluded. (#288)
- Fixed the “Drop files to import” overlay remaining visible after internal drag-and-drop operations such as album reordering. (#289)
- Fixed stale album covers by repairing invalid cover references when loading the album list. (#247)
- Prevented adding albums whose folders overlap an existing album, avoiding conflicting folder trees and synchronization behavior.
- Fixed collection badges and File Info membership remaining stale after removing photos from collections or deleting a collection.
- Fixed redundant sidebar and Smart Album content reloads, reducing unnecessary queries and interruptions during browsing.
- Fixed thumbnail flicker during album scanning.
- Fixed empty filmstrip results leaving preview and navigation controls visible, while preserving the filmstrip preference for later results.
- Fixed slideshows continuing after leaving filmstrip mode or entering Map View.
- Fixed rename dialogs reopening unexpectedly during keyboard navigation. (#296)
- Fixed close-button press-and-hold behavior and improved confirmation and cancellation handling so actions occur on mouse release. (#268)
- Fixed repeated duplicate-deletion submissions and deletion handling for unloaded items in large, virtualized result lists.
- Fixed unreadable images leaving People indexing permanently incomplete.
- Fixed Windows COM initialization error handling.

name: v0.3.1
body:
Lap v0.3.1 focuses on faster, safer library organization and a more capable review workflow. It adds folder search and inline folder creation, improves duplicate and related-photo review, makes album scanning clearer, and strengthens preview, thumbnail, and AI-search reliability across more formats and platforms.

## Highlights

- Folder Search — Search folders directly from the Albums sidebar. Matching folders remain in their album tree with clear highlighting, root-folder context, and favorite-folder filtering. (#260)
- Improved Duplicate Review — Duplicates and Similar Photos now support keep/unkeep actions, selected-item deletion, refresh and reanalyze controls, and more predictable group navigation.
- Related Photo Grouping — Configure a dedicated grouping strictness for Similar Photos, independent of the Find Similar Photos search setting. Exact duplicates are excluded from related-photo analysis.
- Safer Album Management — Album removal now cancels active indexing and waits for folder synchronization, preventing file-database errors during removal.
- Clearer Scan Progress — Album scans now report global progress through discovery, thumbnail generation, and search-data preparation, with detailed indexed, skipped, failed, and merged counts in Album Info.

## New Features and Improvements

- Added inline subfolder creation in the Albums tree, with automatic unique names and keyboard editing.
- Added folder favorite/unfavorite actions and folder file counts.
- Added collection editing from File Info; Collections is always visible and appears before Comment.
- Improved the Add to Collection dialog and collection-list management. (#245)
- Preserved the active collection and tags when using Save As.
- Added a subtle fade to dragged thumbnails and their drag ghost. (#266)
- Added adaptive Calendar heatmap levels for libraries with very different daily photo counts.
- Added search boxes to Smart Albums, Tags, People, and Albums views, with improved empty states.
- Updated welcome content to better introduce Albums, Smart Albums, and Collections.
- Improved grouped keyboard navigation and physical-key support for the Search shortcut on non-English keyboard layouts. (#259)
- Improved collection, Smart Album, and album ordering workflows.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed TIFF thumbnail and preview orientation/dimension handling, including vertical TIFF images.
- Fixed GIF preview playback restarting incorrectly when opening an image.
- Fixed Live Photo comparison viewport synchronization when HEIC and video dimensions differ.
- Fixed preview loading, image positioning, and macOS rename behavior.
- Fixed thumbnail and preview support for additional formats, including Phase One IIQ RAW files. (#253)
- Fixed macOS HEIF support by bundling the required library.
- Fixed manual folder refreshes missing child-folder reconciliation.
- Fixed folder copy and move operations so nested files remain indexed and thumbnail caches follow cross-album moves.
- Fixed renamed-folder recovery using filesystem inode tracking.
- Fixed QuickTime creation-date parsing with timezone offsets.
- Fixed related-photo group deletion and invalid one-item comparison actions.
- Fixed stale content, selection, and grouping updates after file save, move, or delete operations.
- Fixed multilingual AI-search model download validation and added clearer guidance when the default English-only model receives non-English queries. (#255)
- Fixed concurrent album removal and background indexing conflicts.
- Improved drag, collection, deduplication, and sidebar interaction feedback.

name: v0.3.0
body:
Lap v0.3.0 is a major library-management and browsing update. It adds Smart Albums, persistent Collections, native Apple Live Photo support, and a four-pane comparison viewer. The release also makes large libraries faster to browse and search, while bringing a broad round of refinements to grouping, thumbnails, metadata, video, and selection workflows.

This version focuses on helping you find, review, compare, and organize more of your library without breaking the folder-first workflow that Lap is built around.

## Highlights

- **Smart Albums** — Create rule-based albums. Smart Albums support configurable grouping, sorting, ordering, and file-type filters, so saved views can match the way you work. (#29, #179)
- **Collections** — Create persistent Collections tray and drag files into them from anywhere in your library.
- **Apple Live Photos** — Lap now recognizes HEIC/MOV Live Photo pairs, displays a LIVE badge, plays them in the viewer, and keeps linked MOV and AAE sidecars together during rename, move, copy, and delete operations. Companion videos stay out of normal file lists, and pairing is incrementally refreshed during scans. (#123)
- **Four-Pane Comparison** — Compare up to four images side by side in the image viewer, making culling and detailed review much easier. (#121)
- **Faster Large-Library Workflows** — Improved virtualized viewport loading, grouped browsing, semantic-search result loading, and similarity-search calculations reduce work when browsing or searching large libraries.
- **Flexible Library Browsing** — The new Library sidebar brings together all files, favorites, ratings, subjects. Automatic grouping adapts to the active view, including folders, dates, locations, cameras, and lenses.

## New Features and Improvements

- Added configurable media-information badges on thumbnails, including format, ISO, shutter speed, aperture, focal length, and exposure. (#174)
- Added AI PNG prompt import during scanning for Automatic1111, InvokeAI, ComfyUI, and NovelAI images; imported prompts fill empty comments without overwriting your own notes. (#197)
- Added file-type filters to AI Search and Smart Albums, and clearer visual grouping for filename and visual-search results.
- Added background options and a shortcut for the image viewer. (#173)
- Added hover playback for videos and Live Photos in file info, with improved Live Photo playback in the viewer.
- Added multi-file opening in an external application, including confirmation before opening more than 100 files. (#194)
- Added collection-scoped and selected-file-scoped duplicate scans, so deduplication can be targeted to the files you are reviewing.
- Added responsive Calendar columns and clearer grouped thumbnail views, breadcrumbs, sidebar sections, and preview badges.
- Added the current commit hash to the About dialog and a setting for automatic update checks. (#185)
- Refreshed app branding, navigation icons, thumbnail layout, Manage Libraries, and other sidebar and grid controls.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed duplicate-file creation during concurrent album scans. (#190)
- Fixed stale grouping and selection after moving or deleting files, including search-result filenames and visual groups.
- Fixed several Live Photo edge cases, including stale sidecar associations and incorrect sidebar counts.
- Fixed a crash caused by null virtual-scroll thumbnail placeholders. (#203)
- Fixed JPEG capture metadata recovery, lens-model priority, and inconsistent RAW metadata formatting. (#204)
- Improved video playback compatibility and fixed video preview zoom in the file-info panel. (#186)
- Fixed album-folder grouping and selection-restoration flicker. (#199)
- Fixed grouped dedup navigation, multi-select keyboard behavior, filmstrip layout, temporary-view counts, and library loading feedback.
- Improved selection and external-open safeguards for mixed or large selections.

name: v0.2.4
body:
## What's Changed

Lap 0.2.4 is a major usability and compatibility update. 

This release brings real Windows scanning optimizations with over 20%+ performance improvement, expands media support with PSD, EXR plus additional 10+ image formats, and significantly improves day-to-day file operations including drag-and-drop, copy/paste, move/copy workflows, and external file handling.

This version also includes a broad UI polish pass across Lap: cleaner dialogs, improved sidebars and panels, better keyboard navigation, more consistent controls, smoother layout behavior, and a more coherent product experience overall.

Special thanks to @Rockbard for reporting a large number of professional, detailed, and highly actionable issues that helped shape this release!

## New Features

* Windows scanning optimizations with over 20%+ performance improvement
* Support additional 10+ image formats including PSD, EXR, HDR/RGBE, TGA, JPEG 2000 (JP2/J2K/J2C/JPC/JPF/JPX), DDS, DPX, QOI
* Add multi-platform clipboard copy/paste with native Windows, macOS, and Linux support
* Add drag-and-drop files to album folders with copy support (#161)
* Improve file move/copy workflows with conflict handling and external folder operations (#153)
* Import dragged/downloaded files with their original names instead of generated names (#162)
* Allow direct drag-to-reorder for albums without entering edit-list mode (#168) 
* Improve duplicate management panel layout and scan handling (#149)
* Add Settings shortcuts tab with keyboard shortcut display, plus updated content/search shortcuts (#117)
* Add search panel shortcut and improve search focus behavior (#150)
* Support Ctrl+wheel thumbnail resizing and Linux shortcut platform handling (#117)
* Add Tab-key focus cycling between sidebar and content with clearer active-pane selection visuals
* Allow favoriting and excluding the root album folder from search (#158)
* Add loop video playback setting, disabled when auto-play is on (#155)
* Show photo aspect ratio in file info panel and status bar (#152)
* Improve multi-select workflows with keyboard shortcuts, Shift-Arrow key or Ctrl/Cmd-click selection, selection actions, and favorite/rating controls (#154, #153)
* Add EXR thumbnails and previews (#147)
* Add album editing from file info and smarter folder breadcrumbs (#163)
* Add toolbar back button and tooltip for temporary views (#163)
* Add right-click context menus to all sidebar panels and show favorite folder counts
* Add robust macOS drag file path handling
* Localize macOS system dialogs
* Add Homebrew install support for macOS, with automated cask update workflow (#151)
* Standardize modal dialogs with button styling and animation polish

## Bug Fixes

* Fix settings shortcut handling and search loading behavior (#117)
* Preserve selection state across background folder syncs (#157)
* Fix stale folder ID reconciliation and macOS trash handling
* Fix failed thumbnail retry logic by using stale thumbnail state instead of source existence
* Fix infinite recursion in aspect-ratio calculation when dimensions are undefined (#152)
* Fix grid layout anchoring and panel animation issues (#145)
* Fix corrupted thumbnail cache recovery
* Preserve relevance sorting after deleting search results (#166)
* Reduce face clustering memory usage (#95)
* Improve histogram scaling to exclude clipped edge bins (#119)
* Filter hidden files on all platforms during scanning
* Reveal folder contents in Finder instead of selecting the folder itself (#170)
* Stabilize variable grid reverse scrolling (#144)
* Remove duplicate shortcut handlers that caused double dialogs on Windows
* Fix videos taking a long time to load (#156)
* Fix AVIF save-as export
* Guard album scan/sync/index against disconnected external drives
* Fix clipboard image paste on Windows and Linux
* Fix album drag reorder triggering the file-import warning
* Stabilize thumbnail placeholders and polish file info panel behavior

* HEIF/HIF/AVIF Format Support — Full support for HEIC, HEIF, AVIF, and HIF formats on Windows/Linux (#65, #78)

name: v0.2.0
body:
# Release Notes - Lap v0.2.0

Lap v0.2.0 is a major under-the-hood update focused on database efficiency and indexing performance, with broad new video format support across all platforms.

> **Upgrading from v0.1.x?** When upgrading from v0.1.x to v0.2.0, Lap performs a silent database migration. During this one-time process, you may notice slower performance while browsing.

> Recommendation: To speed things up, you can run a full rescan of the album. Alternatively, if you don’t need to preserve metadata such as tags or ratings, you can remove and re-add the album for a clean rebuild.

## 🚀 Highlights

- **Database optimization** reduces database size by over 90% compared to v0.1.x. Future versions will add database backup and restore support to keep your data safe. (#50)
- **Rebuilt scanning engine** cuts album scan time by 100%+, reaching industry-leading performance. A 100K-item library that previously took ~3 hours to scan now completes in approximately 1 hour. Very large libraries maintain consistent performance and a smooth user experience at scale. (#57)
- Expanded **video format support** with broad cross-platform coverage. (#66) Supported formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and 20+ other formats.

## 🐞 Bug Fixes

- Fixed keyboard shortcuts under **non-Latin IME** input. (#59)
- Fixed image edits so saved files correctly **preserve metadata**. (#64)
- Fixed incorrect rotation for images from some **older devices**. (#69)
- Improved cleanup when removing libraries, including active library state updates and database file cleanup.
- Fixed stale thumbnails with cache busting and prevented the adjustment overlay from appearing during image editing.

## 🔧 Other Improvements

- Added keyboard navigation to the tag dialog and improved tag editing UX. Thanks to **Dorito** for the contributions. (#58, #59)
- Centralized navigation sorting settings and simplified album list actions.
- Added a new **vertical filmstrip** in the viewer together with a refined **File Info** experience for faster browsing in large libraries.
- Refined the album file breakdown UI, thumbnail border layout, and edit-image compare preview.
- Made image processing commands asynchronous to keep the UI more responsive during edits and thumbnail work.

## 🙌 Thanks

Many thanks to everyone who reported issues, tested preview builds, and helped improve Lap across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

---
Thank you for using Lap!



**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/julyx10/lap/compare/v0.1.13...v0.2.0
